subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 official action-pin upgrades land as one reviewed batch across secret-bearing and release/security workflows, or should the Codex and GitHub App token updates be isolated first?
rationale: The patch is mechanically consistent, but only the workflow owners can accept the combined operational and security-boundary blast radius of executing all upgraded third-party bundles together.

options.title: Approve the grouped pins
options.body: Review the sensitive action contracts and merge the current exact head after required workflow and security checks complete successfully.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Move Codex action and GitHub App token upgrades into focused PRs so permission, secret, and rollback behavior can be validated independently.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Keep the current pins until the grouped head stops rebasing and produces stable exact-head workflow evidence.

recommendation.title: Approve the grouped pins
recommendation.body: Review the sensitive action contracts and merge the current exact head after required workflow and security checks complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the broadest ownership across the CI, Docker release, action-runtime, and Codex-agent workflow surfaces changed here.
